parts.label: a

questions.prompt: A project team requires 3 engineers, 2 designers, and 1 analyst, selected from 6 engineers, 5 designers, and 4 analysts. One named engineer, Eric, and one named designer, Dana, cannot both be chosen.

parts.label: a

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of teams that can be selected such that Eric and Dana are not both chosen.

questions.prompt: A soccer lineup has 4 forwards, 3 defenders, and 1 goalkeeper, chosen from 6 forwards, 5 defenders, and 3 goalkeepers. One named forward, Felix, and one named defender, Dan, refuse to play on the same lineup.

parts.label: a

parts.label: b

parts.label: b

questions.prompt: A school planning subcommittee of 5 members is chosen from 8 teachers and 6 parents. Two named teachers, Mr Adams and Mrs Baker, cannot both serve on the subcommittee.

parts.label: b

questions.prompt: A youth governing board of 5 members is chosen from 14 candidates, including two co-chairs, Emma and Frank.

parts.label: c

questions.prompt: A medical relief team of 5 is selected from 7 doctors and 6 nurses. One named doctor, Dr Ray, and one named nurse, Nurse Kelly, refuse to work together.

parts.label: b

parts.label: c
